["forever:actionbars","description","Ten action bars plus stance and pet bars with free layout, paging, visibility rules and button styling. Key bindings keep using Blizzard's commands."]
["forever:afkScreen","description","A cinematic Suite screen with your character while you are AFK. Move or use /afk to return."]
["forever:announcements","description","Cinematic zone and event announcements in the Suite look."]

["forever:bags","description","One combined bag with a clear Suite background and item levels on equipment. Keep Blizzard's own item grid, or choose a Suite view with pages, bag groups or categories. Using and sorting items stays Blizzard's."]
["forever:battleRes","description","Show available shared battle resurrections and the next recharge in Mythic+ and raid encounters."]
["forever:buffReminders","description","Clickable reminders for missing personal buffs, chosen aura spells, consumables and weapon enchants. Checks only while out of combat."]
["forever:burningRushCue","description","Show the active Burning Rush aura during combat through Blizzard's native aura container."]

["forever:characterExtras","description","A summary with gem sockets, durability, PvP item level and Great Vault and expansion buttons, durability on the model, cropped slot icons and item levels on equipment choices."]
["forever:characterUpgradeWindow","description","Open your equipment window beside an item upgrade merchant and close only the window MSUF opened."]
["forever:chat","description","Style Blizzard's native chat windows, tabs and input line. Links, channels, filters, docking and message delivery remain Blizzard-owned."]
["forever:chatProfileLinks","description","Copy Raider.IO or Warcraft Logs profile URLs from native character context menus."]
["forever:collectionNewMarkers","description","Clear new mount, pet and toy fanfares acquired while this helper is active."]
["forever:combatLog","description","Start the combat log in the instance types you choose. A log you started manually stays on when you leave."]
["forever:combatMovementCue","description","Briefly show a ready movement spell from your chosen IDs when you start moving."]
["forever:combatPetStatus","description","Show a movable warning when your pet is missing or dead."]
["forever:combatStatsHUD","description","A movable strip for critical strike, haste, mastery and versatility."]

["forever:cooldownManager","description","Cooldowns, buffs and buff bars from Blizzard's Cooldown Manager on fast MSUF bars: a centered stack, defensives and potions on the player frame, custom bars, glows, sounds and per-spell choices."]
["forever:cursorEffects","description","A ring around the mouse pointer that is easy to spot, optionally filled by your global cooldown or cast."]
["forever:dailyComfort","description","Optional shortcuts for tutorials, item deletion and screenshot notices."]

["forever:damageMeter","description","Lightweight meter windows for damage, healing, interrupts, dispels, deaths and damage taken. They read the client's own combat data; Blizzard's meter window stays hidden while this module is active."]
["forever:dataTexts","description","Movable information bars with individually chosen data sources."]
["forever:delveSolePower","description","Automatically choose a Delve power when exactly one safe option is available."]
["forever:dungeonPortals","description","Learned dungeon teleports beside the minimap, with an optional group-join suggestion."]
["forever:durabilityAlert","description","Show a movable warning when equipped gear needs repair. Hidden during combat."]
["forever:enemyCastStack","description","Lists the casts of enemy nameplates in five-player dungeons, oldest first, with timers the game runs."]
["forever:flightTimer","description","Learn flight-master route times, show the route and request landing at the next stop."]
["forever:groupBloodlust","description","Show your Bloodlust exhaustion or ready state while grouped."]
["forever:groupDeathAlert","description","Reports group member deaths in chat during combat."]
["forever:groupFinderApplicantSort","description","Sort Mythic+ applications by average member dungeon score when every score is available."]
["forever:groupFinderDoubleClick","description","Double-click a search result to open Blizzard's normal application dialog."]
["forever:groupFinderExitReminder","description","Show a local reminder when you leave group listings with active applications."]
["forever:groupRaidShortcuts","description","Open Blizzard's raid tools, start a pull countdown, or mark one party tank or healer by command or opt-in automation."]
["forever:guildChatPrivacy","description","Manually cover whole chat windows that contain guild or officer messages."]
["forever:innervateCue","description","Alert a Druid to incoming combat whispers when Innervate may be ready. Optionally outline a chosen MSUF group frame."]
["forever:itemCounts","description","Show your owned item count, including bank and Warband bank, on item tooltips."]
["forever:loadoutReminder","description","Show the active talent build and loot specialization on ready checks or instance entry, with an optional saved expectation."]
["forever:loot","description","Collect all unlocked loot slots at once. Blizzard's own Auto Loot setting stays unchanged; roll decisions stay manual."]
["forever:lootContainers","description","Open newly acquired loot containers one at a time outside combat. Hold Shift to leave them manual."]
["forever:lootToastFilter","description","Show extra compact item notices for Blizzard personal loot toasts matching your rarity and item list."]
["forever:lootVendorRules","description","At a merchant, review and confirm sales from an explicit item ID list."]
["forever:macroBuilder","description","Preview a mouseover or focus spell macro and create it on your character with /msufmacro."]
["forever:mapLandingShortcuts","description","Open expansion, Great Vault, Adventure Guide and map pages from a small menu by the minimap."]
["forever:merchantLevel","description","Show the item level on equipment sold by a merchant."]
["forever:merchantList","description","The merchant's whole stock in one scrolling list with prices, quality colors and item levels."]

["forever:minimap","description","A clean minimap in its own frame: size, shape, border, zoom, Blizzard buttons, an addon button drawer and information texts. Blizzard's minimap buttons keep working."]
["forever:mythicKeyShare","description","Show or share your key with /keys; /keys group requests keys from Suite users in your group."]
["forever:mythicResetReminder","description","Show a local reminder when Blizzard reports a Mythic+ reset."]
["forever:nameplates","description","The Mapko skin for Blizzard nameplates. Blizzard keeps health, threat, casts, auras, selection and click handling."]
["forever:objectives","description","An MSUF-owned objective tracker with grouped, readable entries."]
["forever:partyEffects","description","Animated color flashes that celebrate a level, an achievement or Bloodlust, at random times if you like, and can spin the Suite action bars once."]

["forever:popupAttention","description","A Suite look, font, minimum height and position for Blizzard dialogs, marked resurrection offers, the item quality written on loot toasts and gold-framed money toasts."]
["forever:professionAppearance","description","Remove selected profession outfit auras outside combat. Fishing is excluded to preserve fishing-rod effects."]
["forever:qol","description","Repair equipment and sell poor-quality items when a merchant opens. Hold Shift to skip selling."]
["forever:quests","description","Accept and turn in quests automatically. Hold Shift to pause. Reward choices and quests with a money cost stay manual."]
["forever:quietPopups","description","Independently hide Talking Head, Boss Banner and Quick Join toasts while retaining Blizzard's underlying events."]
["forever:releaseProtection","description","Require a held modifier key before clicking Release Spirit in the death dialog."]
["forever:runSummary","description","A movable summary after a Mythic+ run or raid boss kill."]
["forever:skyriding","description","Movable MSUF flight display for speed, Vigor, Second Wind and Whirling Surge."]
["forever:socketGemSuggestions","description","Show carried gems beside Blizzard's socket window for manual review."]
["forever:targetDistance","description","Movable approximate target range from native spell checks. Values include the target's hitbox; unavailable ranges show dashes."]
["forever:threatMeter","description","Your group's threat on the enemy you watch, read from Blizzard's own threat data, with an optional second window for your focus."]
["forever:tooltipClassColors","description","Color player names by class on the main tooltip."]
["forever:tooltipDetails","description","General tooltips, guild rank, target, item levels and item details. MSUF unit-frame tooltip anchors remain separate."]
["forever:tooltipIDs","description","Hold Alt to show item, spell, creature, quest, currency and temporary weapon enchant IDs on the main tooltip."]
["forever:tooltipMPlusScore","description","Show a player's public current-season Mythic+ score on their main tooltip."]
["forever:tooltipSpellCopy","description","Select the last public spell tooltip ID for copying with /msufcopyspell."]
["forever:tooltipVisibility","description","Optionally hide the main tooltip in combat, instances or for selected content types."]
["forever:trainerLearnAll","description","Review the total cost, then learn available non-profession abilities at a trainer."]
["forever:trustedPartyInvites","description","Accept ordinary party invites from selected friends or guild members when no queue or confirmation would be lost."]
["forever:uiErrorFilter","description","Choose individual recurring UI errors to hide with Blizzard's own message filter."]
["forever:vaultSpec","description","Show your selected loot specialization in the Great Vault window."]
["forever:waypoints","description","Set a native map waypoint with /way x y or /msufway x y."]
["forever:xpBar","description","Movable experience bar with rested XP, session gain, XP per hour and time to level."]
